title: The Global T20 Nomad: DA Warner's Journey Across 8 Leagues
summary: DA Warner has played in 8 T20 leagues (BBL, BPL, CPL, ILT20, IPL), scoring 12097 runs at 37.3.
body:
## 8 Leagues, One Mission

DA Warner is one of T20 cricket's true globetrotters. From the IPL to the BBL, from the CPL to the PSL, he's plied his trade across **8 different T20 leagues**: BBL, BPL, CPL, ILT20, IPL, MLC, PSL, T20I.

**Career Numbers:** 12097 runs | 371 innings | Avg 37.3 | SR 139.9

That kind of cross-league experience shapes a player. Different pitches, different pressure, different tactical demands — and Warner has delivered across all of them.

---
*Data across 8 T20 leagues. Analysis by MatchPrism.*
